usedFor: AgentMail sends and receives the email, and Freshsales Classic holds the deals that “Update Deal” changes after each email event.

bestTemplate.name: “New Email Bounced” in AgentMail, then “Update Deal” in Freshsales Classic
bestTemplate.why: A bounce carries the bounce type and recipients, so the deal can show that the message never landed.

watchOut: “Update Deal” finds the deal by ID or name, so the email event must supply one of them.
